name: Dibri
title: Danite, father of Shelomith
summary: Dibri was a man from the tribe of Dan, the father of Shelomith. Her son, whose father was Egyptian, blasphemed the name of the Lord in the wilderness and was stoned by God's judgment.

keyEvents.title: Father of Shelomith
keyEvents.description: Shelomith, daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, was the mother of the man who blasphemed the name of the Lord.
